fields.Name: T322 - New Routine Editor Schedule Frequency Builder
fields.Description: Exercises the NewRoutine editor's segmented ScheduleKind control and the reactive @switch schedule-detail builder plus the derived SchedulePreview — bespoke schedule-composition UI with no equivalent in the generic form suite.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Routines app, click 'New Routine' to open the editor. Wait for the editor to render (10-30s possible). The editor shows a Name field, an agent picker, a per-run message box, and a 'Frequency' segmented control with options like Hourly / Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Advanced. Click 'Weekly' (or 'Daily'), then click 'Advanced', and observe that the schedule-detail area below changes to match the selected frequency (e.g. a day-of-week + time picker for Weekly, a raw cron-expression text box for Advanced) and a schedule preview line updates. Success is seeing the frequency control switch the detail inputs — you do NOT need to save.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'New Routine' opens an editor with a Name field, an agent picker, and a 'Frequency' segmented control
Selecting different frequency options (e.g. Weekly, Advanced) changes the schedule-detail inputs shown below (day/time pickers vs a cron expression field)
A schedule preview / calendar line is visible and reflects the current schedule choice
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
